Initial release of the Generate Private K-12 School Client Education Handout skill.

- Enables creation of polished explainer handouts with visuals, FAQs, and next steps tailored for private K-12 schools.
- Designed for use by school administrators and enrollment marketers handling client education.
- Integrates chat and image generation APIs for enhanced, visually appealing outputs.
- Includes a step-by-step workflow for audience clarification, drafting, enrichment, and refinement.
- Optimized for discoverability with SEO-targeted keywords and suggested prompts.
